Question
========
Sen's capability approach shifts the focus from ...

Answerlist
----------
* what people have to what they are able to do and to be
* opportunities to outcomes measured in money
* individuals to social classes
* national to global income

Solution
========
Capabilities are the real freedoms to achieve valued functionings. Resources matter only insofar as people can convert them into functionings.
